-- [[ CLOVERLOG ]] --
local function CHLog(label, state)
	local prefix = "[CloverHub-SAE]"
	if state == "start" then
		print(prefix .. " ⏳ " .. label .. " starting...")
	elseif state == "wait" then
		print(prefix .. " 🔄 " .. label .. " ... wait a sec ...")
	elseif state == "done" then
		print(prefix .. " ✅ " .. label .. " loaded.")
	elseif state == "fail" then
		warn(prefix .. " ❌ " .. label .. " failed.")
	else
		print(prefix .. " [" .. tostring(state) .. "] " .. label)
	end
end

}

local func10

func10 = function(param6)
	local n = tonumber(param6) or 0
	local str9 = n < 0
	local n2 = math.abs(n)

	for _, item9 in ipairs({ { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } }) do
		if n2 >= item9[1] then
			local n3 = math.floor(n2 / item9[1] * 10) / 10
			local num1 = n3 % 1 == 0 and tostring(math.floor(n3)) or string.format("%.1f", n3)
			str9 = str9 and "-" or ""
			return str9 .. num1 .. item9[2]
		end
	end

	return (str9 and "-" or "") .. tostring(math.floor(n2))
end

local func11

func11 = function(param7)
	local n = math.floor(param7)
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", math.floor(n / 3600), math.floor(n % 3600 / 60), n % 60)
end

local func12

func12 = function(param8)
	local floor = math.floor
	local n = param8.B * 255 + 0.5
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(param8.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(param8.G * 255 + 0.5), floor(n))
end

local func13

func13 = function(delay2, flag11)
	task.wait(delay2 + math.random() * ((flag11 or delay2) - delay2))
end

local func14

func14 = function()
	local list5 = {}

	pcall(function()
		local tbl8 = {}

		for _, rarity in pairs(require(ReplicatedStorage.Data.Rarity).Rarities) do
			if type(rarity) == "table" and rarity._id and not tbl8[rarity._id] then
				tbl8[rarity._id] = true

				list5[#list5 + 1] = {
					id = rarity._id,
					num = tonumber(rarity.RarityNumber or rarity.Rank) or 0,
					color = rarity.Color,
					odds = rarity.DefaultRarityValue,
				}
			end
		end

		table.sort(list5, function(param9, param10)
			if param9.num ~= param10.num then
				return param9.num > param10.num
			end
			return param9.id < param10.id
		end)
	end)

	return list5
end

-- Draggable visibility button (mobile toggle)
do
	if type(lua.AddDraggableButton) == "function" then
		obj1.__VisibilityButton = lua:AddDraggableButton("Clover", function() end, true, false)
		local visibilityControl = obj1.__VisibilityButton
		local visibilityButton = visibilityControl and visibilityControl.Button
		if visibilityButton then
			local inputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
			local pressButtonPosition
			local pressVisualInput
			local dragTolerance = lua.IsMobile and 14 or 8
			local visibilityRequestId = 0
			local visibilityRetryDelay = math.max(0.08, (lua.WindowAnimationInfo and lua.WindowAnimationInfo.Time or 0.2) + 0.04)
			local pressScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
			pressScale.Name = "CloverPressScale"
			pressScale.Scale = 1
			pressScale.Parent = visibilityButton
			local pressTween
			local pressInInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.075, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			local pressOutInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
			visibilityButton.Name = "CloverHubVisibilityButton"
			visibilityButton.Active = true
			visibilityButton.Selectable = true
			visibilityButton.Interactable = true
			visibilityButton.AutoButtonColor = false
			visibilityButton.RichText = true
			visibilityButton.TextSize = 15
			visibilityButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 32)
			visibilityButton.ZIndex = 100
			visibilityButton:SetAttribute("CloverHubInputMode", "Activated")
			visibilityButton:SetAttribute("CloverHubDragTolerance", dragTolerance)
			visibilityButton:SetAttribute("CloverHubPressScale", 0.965)

			local function tweenVisibilityButtonScale(targetScale, tweenInfo)
				if not pressScale.Parent then return end
				if pressTween then pcall(function() pressTween:Cancel() end) end
				pressTween = TweenService:Create(pressScale, tweenInfo, { Scale = targetScale })
				pressTween:Play()
			end

			local function refreshVisibilityButton()
				local windowOpen = lua.Toggled == true
				if obj1.MainFrame then windowOpen = obj1.MainFrame.Visible end
				visibilityButton:SetAttribute("CloverHubWindowOpen", windowOpen)
				visibilityButton.Text = windowOpen
					and '<b><font color="#58E083">Clover</font></b>'
					or '<b><font color="#C4C9D1">Clover</font></b>'
			end

			local function applyVisibilityRequest(requestId, desiredOpen, attempt)
				if requestId ~= visibilityRequestId or not isAlive() or not visibilityButton.Parent then return end
				obj1:Toggle(desiredOpen)
				refreshVisibilityButton()
				if lua.Toggled == desiredOpen then
					visibilityButton:SetAttribute("CloverHubToggleQueued", false)
					return
				end
				if attempt < 4 then
					visibilityButton:SetAttribute("CloverHubToggleQueued", true)
					task.delay(visibilityRetryDelay, function()
						applyVisibilityRequest(requestId, desiredOpen, attempt + 1)
					end)
				else
					visibilityButton:SetAttribute("CloverHubToggleQueued", false)
				end
			end

			local function requestVisibilityToggle()
				visibilityRequestId = visibilityRequestId + (1)
				applyVisibilityRequest(visibilityRequestId, lua.Toggled ~= true, 1)
			end

			lua:GiveSignal(visibilityButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				local inputType = input.UserInputType
				if inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					pressButtonPosition = visibilityButton.AbsolutePosition
					pressVisualInput = input
					tweenVisibilityButtonScale(0.965, pressInInfo)
				end
			end))

			lua:GiveSignal(inputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if input ~= pressVisualInput then return end
				pressVisualInput = nil
				tweenVisibilityButtonScale(1, pressOutInfo)
			end))

			lua:GiveSignal(visibilityButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				local startPosition = pressButtonPosition
				pressButtonPosition = nil
				if startPosition and (visibilityButton.AbsolutePosition - startPosition).Magnitude > dragTolerance then return end
				requestVisibilityToggle()
			end))

			if obj1.MainFrame then
				lua:GiveSignal(obj1.MainFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(refreshVisibilityButton))
			end
			refreshVisibilityButton()
		end
	end
end

-- Responsive UI scale for mobile
do
	local BASE_WINDOW_SIZE = Vector2.new(680, 540)
	local WINDOW_MARGIN = 24
	local function applyResponsiveUIScale()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return 1 end
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		local scale = math.min(1, (viewport.X - WINDOW_MARGIN) / BASE_WINDOW_SIZE.X, (viewport.Y - WINDOW_MARGIN) / BASE_WINDOW_SIZE.Y)
		scale = math.clamp(scale, 0.55, 1)
		if type(lua.SetDPIScale) == "function" then lua:SetDPIScale(scale * 100) end
		local mainFrame = lua.ScreenGui and lua.ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
		if mainFrame and mainFrame:IsA("GuiObject") then
			mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(BASE_WINDOW_SIZE.X * scale) / 2, 0.5, -(BASE_WINDOW_SIZE.Y * scale) / 2)
		end
		return scale
	end
	applyResponsiveUIScale()
end

-- Mobile scroll fix
obj1.__ApplyMobileScrollFix = function(onlyTab)
	local inputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	if not (lua.IsMobile or inputService.TouchEnabled) then return end
	for _, tab in ipairs(onlyTab and { onlyTab } or { home, eggs, progression, sell, event, obj1.__WebhookTab, settings_ }) do
		for _, side in ipairs(tab.Sides or {}) do
			pcall(function()
				side.Active = true
				side.ScrollingEnabled = true
				side.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
				side.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.WhenScrollable
				side.ScrollBarThickness = 0
				side.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 1
				side.VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.None
			end)
			for _, nested in ipairs(side:GetDescendants()) do
				if nested:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and nested.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y <= nested.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y + 2 then
					nested.ScrollingEnabled = false
					nested.Active = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	flag12.CreatePersistence = function(obj)

		local function func20()
			if not value32 then
				return false
			end

			for k, setting in pairs(obj.settings) do
				if k == "Stall" then
					continue
				end

				if tbl13[k] then
					setting = false
				end

				local entry4 = value32[k]

				if type(setting) == "table" then
					if type(entry4) ~= "table" then

					end

				end

					return false
				end
			end

				if not tbl13[k] and obj.settings[k] == nil then
					return false
				end
			end

			return true
		end

					return false

				end

				if flag26 or not result2 then
					flag24 = true
				end

				return ok2 and result2 == true
			end,
		}
	end

handlers.RiftPlanner.Signature = function(obj)
	if type(obj) ~= "table" or type(obj.Requirements) ~= "table" or #obj.Requirements ~= 3 then
		return nil
	end
	local list9 = {}
	local func21 = tostring
	local bannerId = obj.BannerId or ""

	do
		local values = table.pack(func21(bannerId))
		table.move(values, 1, values.n, 1, list9)
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local flag31 = obj.Requirements[i]
		if type(flag31) ~= "string" or flag31 == "" then
			return nil
		end
		list9[#list9 + 1] = flag31
	end

	return table.concat(list9, "\31")
end

handlers.RiftPlanner.ValueAllowed = function(flag32, flag33, flag34)
	if type(flag34) ~= "number" or flag34 ~= flag34 or flag34 < 0 or flag34 >= math.huge then
		return false
	end

	if flag33 ~= true or type(flag32) ~= "number" or flag32 ~= flag32 or flag32 < 0 or flag32 >= math.huge then
		return false
	end
	return flag34 == 0 or flag32 < flag34
end

handlers.RiftPlanner.Action = function(flag35, param16, param17, param18, param19, list10)
	if not flag35 then
		return "off"
	end

	if param16 then
		return "transaction"
	end

	if param17 then
		return "normal"
	end

	if param19 then
		return "claim"
	end

	if not list10 then
		return "state"
	end

	if list10.ready then
		return "trade"
	end

	for _, slot in ipairs(list10.slots) do
		if slot.eggUid and not slot.placed then
			return "place"
		end
	end

	if next(list10.missing) ~= nil then
		return "collect"
	end
	return "hatch"
end

handlers.RiftPlanner.PlanEggs = function(obj, list11)

	if not flag36 then
		return nil
	end
	local tbl14 = { signature = flag36, slots = {}, pets = {}, eggs = {}, missing = {}, ready = true }

	for i, requirement in ipairs(obj.Requirements) do
		local value36 = nil

		for _, item13 in ipairs(list11) do
			if item13.category == requirement and not item13.placed and not tbl14.eggs[item13.uid] and (not value36 or item13.value < value36.value or item13.value == value36.value and item13.uid < value36.uid) then
				value36 = item13
			end
		end

		local tbl15 = { category = requirement }

		if value36 then
			local uid = value36.uid
			local uid2 = value36.uid
			tbl14.eggs[uid] = true
			tbl15.eggUid = uid2
		else
			tbl14.ready = false
			tbl14.missing[requirement] = (tbl14.missing[requirement] or 0) + 1
		end

		tbl14.slots[i] = tbl15
	end

	return tbl14
end

handlers.wakeOverlay = function(statusWakePending)
	if not isAlive() then
		return
	end
	handlers.statusWakePending = statusWakePending or "status"
	if handlers.statusWakeBusy then
		return
	end
	handlers.statusWakeBusy = true

	task.defer(function()
		while isAlive() and handlers.statusWakePending ~= nil do
			local statusWakePending2 = handlers.statusWakePending
			handlers.statusWakePending = nil

			pcall(function()
				handlers.statusWake:Fire(statusWakePending2)
			end)

			task.wait(handlers.presentationInterval())
		end

		handlers.statusWakeBusy = false
	end)
end

do
	local tbl16 = { [""] = 1, k = 1000, m = 1000000, b = 1e9, t = 1e12 }
	local tbl17 = { { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } }

	local function func23(flag44)
		return type(flag44) == "number" and flag44 == flag44 and flag44 >= 0 and flag44 < math.huge
	end

	handlers.parseCompactValue = function(flag45)
		if type(flag45) == "number" then
			flag45 = func23(flag45) and flag45 or nil
			return flag45
		end
		local str15 = tostring(flag45 or ""):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
		if str15 == "" then
			return 0
		end

		if str15:sub(1, 1) == "$" then
			str15 = str15:sub(2)
		end

		if str15 == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local match, value39 = str15:match("^([%d,]*%.?%d+)(%a*)$")
		local entry6 = tbl16[value39]
		if not match or not entry6 then
			return nil
		end
		local match2 = match:match("^([^%.]*)") or ""

		if match2 == "" then
			match2 = "0"
		end

		if match2:find(",", 1, true) then
			local match3, obj9 = match2:match("^(%d%d?%d?)(,.*)$")
			if not match3 or not obj9 or obj9:gsub(",%d%d%d", "") ~= "" then
				return nil
			end
		elseif not match2:match("^%d+$") then
			return nil
		end

		local func24 = tonumber
		local str16 = match:gsub(",", "")
		local n = func24(str16)
		n = n and n * entry6 or nil
		return func23(n) and n or nil
	end

	handlers.formatCompactValue = function(param35)
		local n = tonumber(param35) or 0
		if not func23(n) or n == 0 then
			return "0"
		end
		local n2 = 1
		local str17 = ""

		for _, item14 in ipairs(tbl17) do
			if n >= item14[1] then
				n2 = item14[1]
				str17 = item14[2]
				break
			end
		end

		return ("%.6f"):format(n / n2):gsub("(%..-)0+$", "%1"):gsub("%.$", "") .. str17
	end

	handlers.formatThresholdConfirmation = function(param36)
		local n = tonumber(param36) or 0
		if not func23(n) or n == 0 then
			return "0"
		end
		local n2 = 1
		local str18 = ""
		local value40 = nil

		for i, item15 in ipairs(tbl17) do
			if n >= item15[1] then
				n2 = item15[1]
				str18 = item15[2]
				value40 = i
				break
			else
				value40 = nil
			end
		end

		local function func25(num4, param37)
			local n3 = n / num4
			return ("%%.%df"):format(n3 >= 100 and 0 or n3 >= 10 and 1 or n3 >= 1 and 2 or num4 == 1 and 6 or 2):format(n3):gsub("(%..-)0+$", "%1"):gsub("%.$", ""), param37
		end

		local str19, str20 = func25(n2, str18)

		if tonumber(str19) and tonumber(str19) >= 1000 and value40 and value40 > 1 then
			local entry7 = tbl17[value40 - 1]
			str19, str20 = func25(entry7[1], entry7[2])
		end

		return str19 .. str20
	end

	handlers.setCommittedThresholdCaption = function(obj, param38, param39)
		if type(obj) ~= "table" or type(obj.SetText) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local value41 = handlers.formatThresholdConfirmation(param39)
		local str21 = ("%s: <font color=\"#49E685\"><b>%s</b></font>"):format(tostring(param38), value41)

		return pcall(function()
			obj:SetText(str21)
		end)
	end

	handlers.valueFilterActive = function(param40)
		return (tonumber(param40) or 0) > 0
	end

	handlers.markValueFilterChanged = function()
		handlers.valueFilterReadyAt = os.clock() + 0.75
	end

	handlers.sellerValueFilterReady = function(flag46)
		if handlers.valueFilterLoadInProgress == true then
			return false
		end

		if os.clock() < (tonumber(handlers.valueFilterReadyAt) or 0) then
			return false
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetFocusedTextBox()
		end)

		if not (ok and result == nil) then
			return false
		end
		local valueFilterInputs = flag46 and handlers.valueFilterInputs and handlers.valueFilterInputs[flag46] or nil

		if valueFilterInputs and type(valueFilterInputs.ReadText) == "function" then
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(valueFilterInputs.ReadText)
			local flag47 = ok2 and handlers.parseCompactValue(result2) or nil
			if flag47 == nil or flag47 ~= tonumber(tbl9[flag46]) then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	handlers.addValueFilterInput = function(obj10, param41, param42, param43, param44, flag48)
		local flag49 = false
		local value42 = handlers.formatCompactValue(tbl9[param42])
		local flag50 = handlers.parseCompactValue(value42)

		if flag50 ~= nil then
			tbl9[param42] = flag50
		end

		local obj11 = obj10:AddInput(param41, {
			Text = param43,
			Default = value42,
			Numeric = false,
			Finished = true,
			Placeholder = "750M / 1.25B / 2T",
			Tooltip = flag48 or "Uses $/s. K, M, B, T work; 0 disables.",
		})

		local function func26()
			handlers.setCommittedThresholdCaption(obj11, param43, tbl9[param42])
		end

		func26()

		local function func27(param45)
			local value43 = handlers.formatCompactValue(param45)
			flag49 = true

			pcall(function()
				obj11:SetValue(value43)
			end)

			flag49 = false
		end

		local function func28(param46, flag51)
			if flag49 then
				return false
			end
			handlers.markValueFilterChanged()
			local flag52 = handlers.parseCompactValue(param46)

			if flag52 == nil then
				func27(tbl9[param42])

				pcall(function()
					lua:Notify("Use a value like 750M, 1.25B, or 2T.", 4)
				end)

				if param44 then
					pcall(param44, "invalid")
				end

				return false
			end

			local value44 = handlers.formatCompactValue(flag52)
			local flag53 = handlers.parseCompactValue(value44)
			if flag53 == nil then
				return false
			end
			local num5 = tonumber(tbl9[param42]) ~= flag53
			tbl9[param42] = flag53
			func27(flag53)
			func26()

			if num5 and param44 then
				pcall(param44, flag51 or "user")
			end

			return true
		end

		obj11:OnChanged(function(param47)
			func28(param47, "user")
		end)

		local textBox = obj11.Holder and obj11.Holder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextBox", true)

		if textBox then
			local connection = textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				if flag49 then
					return
				end
				func28(textBox.Text, "blur")
			end)

			if type(obj11.Connections) == "table" then
				table.insert(obj11.Connections, connection)
			else
				handlers.valueFilterInputConnections = handlers.valueFilterInputConnections or {}
				table.insert(handlers.valueFilterInputConnections, connection)
			end
		end

		handlers.valueFilterInputs = handlers.valueFilterInputs or {}

		handlers.valueFilterInputs[param42] = {
			ReadText = function()
				return textBox and textBox.Text or obj11.Value
			end,
			Commit = function()
				return func28(textBox and textBox.Text or obj11.Value, "blur")
			end,
		}

		local chsaeConfigControllers = getgenv().__CHSAE_ConfigControllers

		if type(chsaeConfigControllers) == "table" then
			chsaeConfigControllers[param42] = {
				GetValue = function()
					return tbl9[param42]
				end,
				SetValue = function(param48, param49)
					handlers.markValueFilterChanged()
					local flag54 = handlers.parseCompactValue(param49)

					if flag54 == nil then
						flag54 = tonumber(tbl9[param42])
						flag54 = func23(flag54) and flag54 or 0
					end

					local value45 = handlers.formatCompactValue(flag54)
					local flag55 = handlers.parseCompactValue(value45)
					tbl9[param42] = flag55 ~= nil and flag55 or 0
					func27(tbl9[param42])
					func26()

					if param44 then
						pcall(param44, "config")
					end
				end,
			}
		end

		return obj11
	end
end

handlers.finishStealTimer = function(param50, param51)
	local stealTimer = handlers.stealTimer
	local last = math.max(0, (tonumber(param50) or 0) + (tonumber(param51) or 0))
	stealTimer.active = false
	stealTimer.last = last
	stealTimer.outTime = tonumber(param50) or 0
	stealTimer.backTime = tonumber(param51) or 0
	stealTimer.completed = (tonumber(stealTimer.completed) or 0) + 1
	stealTimer.total = (tonumber(stealTimer.total) or 0) + last
	stealTimer.average = stealTimer.total / stealTimer.completed
	handlers.set("stealTime", ("⏱️ Time: %.2fs · %.2f out / %.2f back"):format(last, stealTimer.outTime, stealTimer.backTime))
	pcall(sessionMetrics.Set, sessionMetrics, "stealTime", ("%.2fs"):format(last))
	pcall(sessionMetrics.Set, sessionMetrics, "avgStealTime", ("%.2fs"):format(stealTimer.average))
end

handlers.pauseStealTimer = function()
	local stealTimer = handlers.stealTimer
	if not stealTimer.active then
		return false
	end
	stealTimer.active = false
	handlers.wakeOverlay("steal-timer-paused")
	return true
end

		else
			handlers.statusWake.Event:Wait()
		end
	end
end)

handlers.failSameServerRejoin = function(flag56, flag57)
	if not handlers.sameServerRejoinPending then
		return
	end

	if flag57 ~= nil and handlers.sameServerRejoinAttempt ~= flag57 then
		return
	end
	handlers.sameServerRejoinPending = false
	handlers.sameServerRejoinAttempt = nil
	handlers.intentionalDisconnectUntil = 0
	lua:Notify("⚠️ Same-server rejoin failed: " .. tostring(flag56 or "Teleport failed"), 5)
end

handlers.requestSameServerRejoin = function()
	if handlers.sameServerRejoinPending or handlers.serverHopPending then
		lua:Notify("⚠️ another teleport is already pending", 4)
		return false
	end
	local placeId = game.PlaceId
	local jobId = game.JobId
	if type(jobId) ~= "string" or jobId == "" then
		lua:Notify("⚠️ Same-server rejoin failed: job id unavailable", 5)
		return false
	end
	handlers.sameServerRejoinPending = true
	local sameServerRejoinAttempt = {}
	handlers.sameServerRejoinAttempt = sameServerRejoinAttempt
	handlers.intentionalDisconnectUntil = os.clock() + 45

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, jobId, localPlayer)
		end)

		if not ok then
			handlers.failSameServerRejoin(result, sameServerRejoinAttempt)
		end
	end)

	task.delay(45, function()
		if isAlive() and handlers.sameServerRejoinAttempt == sameServerRejoinAttempt then
			handlers.failSameServerRejoin("teleport timed out", sameServerRejoinAttempt)
		end
	end)

	return true
end

pcall(function()
	getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns[#getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns + 1] = TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(flag58, param52, param53)
		if flag58 ~= localPlayer then
			return
		end

		if os.clock() < (tonumber(handlers.intentionalDisconnectUntil) or 0) then
			handlers.failSameServerRejoin(param53)
		end
	end)
end)

			return

				local ok, result = pcall(eggRecords.ToAssetItemData, param69)

				if ok and type(result) == "table" then
					itemData = result
				end
			end
		end

		local assetEarnings = tbl47 and tbl47.AssetEarnings

		if type(itemData) == "table" and assetEarnings and type(assetEarnings.MutationOnlyRatePerSecond) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(assetEarnings.MutationOnlyRatePerSecond, itemData)

			if ok and type(result) == "number" then
				flag81 = result
			end
		end
	end)

	if type(flag81) == "number" and flag81 == flag81 and flag81 > -math.huge and flag81 < math.huge then
		return math.max(flag81, 0), true
	end
	local n2 = nil

	pcall(function()
		if type(param69) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local itemData = type(param69.ItemData) == "table" and param69.ItemData or param69
		local assetCategory = itemData.AssetCategory or itemData.Category or param69.AssetCategory or param69.Category
		local assetScale = itemData.AssetScale or itemData.Scale or param69.AssetScale or param69.Scale
		local flag82 = Assets.Directory[assetCategory]
		local num10 = tonumber(flag82 and flag82.EarningRate)
		if not num10 or tonumber(assetScale) == nil then
			return
		end
		local list20 = func53(param69)
		local len = #list20 > 0 and flag70
		local n3 = 1

		if len then
			local ok, result = pcall(flag70.GetTotalMutationsEarningMulti, list20)

			if ok and tonumber(result) then
				n3 = tonumber(result)
			end
		end

	end

	end

	end

handlers.guardRoutePoints = function(obj, param160, flag240, instance14)

									local flag256 = type(result3) == "table" and tonumber(result3.AwardedAmount) or nil
									func166(flag256 and flag256 > 0 and "💰 Collected $" .. func10(flag256) or "💰 Pen cash collected")
								end
							end
						end

						if tbl9.AutoClaimIndex and now3 >= n4 then
							n4 = now3 + 15

							if value197 and value200 and value200.REQUEST_CLAIM_ALL and flag121.backgroundOk() then
								local ok, result, result2, result3 = pcall(value197.Invoke, value200.REQUEST_CLAIM_ALL)

								if ok and result == true and type(result3) == "table" and next(result3) ~= nil then
									func166("🎁 Index rewards claimed")
								end
							end
						end

						task.wait(0.5)
					end
				end
			end)

			if not (ok or not isAlive()) then
				warn("[CloverHub-SAE][pen] worker recovered: " .. tostring(result))
				task.wait(1)
				continue
			end

			break
		end
	end)
end

		local active2 = handlers.stealTimer.active == true and type(chsaeCarryRequest) == "table"

		if active2 and func59(chsaeCarryRequest.uid, chsaeCarryRequest.category, chsaeCarryRequest.claimSequenceAtStart) then
			handlers.inventoryFullGraceUntil = 0
			func38("🟠 Inventory full · finalizing steal")
			return false
		end

		if active2 and chsaeCarryRequest.carrySeen == true then
			local now3 = os.clock()
			local inventoryFullGraceUntil = tonumber(handlers.inventoryFullGraceUntil) or 0

			if inventoryFullGraceUntil <= 0 then
				inventoryFullGraceUntil = now3 + 0.25
				handlers.inventoryFullGraceUntil = inventoryFullGraceUntil
			end

			if now3 < inventoryFullGraceUntil then
				if not handlers.inventoryFullGraceScheduled then
					handlers.inventoryFullGraceScheduled = true

					task.delay(math.max(0.01, inventoryFullGraceUntil - now3), function()
						handlers.inventoryFullGraceScheduled = false

						if isAlive() and AutoStealToggle and AutoStealToggle.Value == true then
							local value263, value264, value265 = handlers.eggInventoryCapacityState()

							if value263 then
								handlers.stopAutoStealForFullInventory(value264, value265, flag300)
							else
								handlers.inventoryFullGraceUntil = 0
							end
						end
					end)
				end

				return false
			end
		end

		handlers.inventoryFullGraceUntil = 0

		if tbl9.SellEggsWhenFull then
			if type(chsaeCarryRequest) == "table" and chsaeCarryRequest.inFlight ~= true then
				getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest = nil
			end

			critical = false
			str57.treadmillSuppressed = false
			local value266 = flag121
			flag121.stealWants = false
			value266.critical = false
			flag121.release("Steal")
			handlers.pauseStealTimer()
			handlers.carry = "📦 Carry: none"
			handlers.set("target", "🎯 Target: none")
			func38(("🟠 Eggs full %d/%d · selling matches"):format(tonumber(param188) or 0, tonumber(param189) or 0))
			return false
		end

		local flag301 = AutoStealToggle and AutoStealToggle.Value == true
		tbl9.AutoSteal = false

		local function func189()
			if not (isAlive() and AutoStealToggle) then
				return
			end

			if AutoStealToggle.Value then
				handlers.automaticStealStop = true
			end

			pcall(AutoStealToggle.SetValue, AutoStealToggle, false)
			tbl9.AutoSteal = false
		end

		func189()
		task.defer(func189)
		handlers.inventoryFullStopped = true
		str57.treadmillSuppressed = false
		func40()

		if type(chsaeCarryRequest) == "table" and chsaeCarryRequest.inFlight ~= true then
			getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest = nil
		end

		local value267 = flag121
		flag121.stealWants = false
		value267.critical = false
		flag121.release("Steal")
		handlers.carry = "📦 Carry: none"
		handlers.pauseStealTimer()
		handlers.set("target", "🎯 Target: none")
		func38("🟠 Inventory full · Auto-Steal off")
		local flag302 = not flag299

		if flag302 then
			flag302 = os.clock() - (handlers.inventoryFullAlertAt or -math.huge) >= 600
		end

		if flag302 then
			flag299 = true
			handlers.inventoryFullAlertAt = os.clock()

			local pendingInventoryFullAlert = {
				count = tonumber(param188) or 0,
				capacity = tonumber(param189) or 0,
				reason = tostring(flag300 or "Egg inventory is full"),
			}

			if type(handlers.sendWebhook) == "function" then
				task.spawn(handlers.sendWebhook, "inventory-full", "Egg Inventory Full", ("Auto-Steal was turned off. Egg inventory: **%d / %d**."):format(pendingInventoryFullAlert.count, pendingInventoryFullAlert.capacity), 16096779, false)
			else
				handlers.pendingInventoryFullAlert = pendingInventoryFullAlert
			end

			lua:Notify(("🥚 Inventory full (%d/%d) · Auto-Steal turned off."):format(pendingInventoryFullAlert.count, pendingInventoryFullAlert.capacity), 6)
		end

		return flag301
	end

	pcall(function()
		local EggInventory = value259.ConnectForDataChanged("EggInventory", function()
			local flag303, value268, value269 = handlers.eggInventoryCapacityState()

			if not flag303 then
				local inventoryFullStopped2 = handlers.inventoryFullStopped == true and not tbl9.Stall
				flag299 = false
				handlers.inventoryFullStopped = false
				handlers.inventoryFullGraceUntil = 0

				if inventoryFullStopped2 and AutoStealToggle and not AutoStealToggle.Value then
					task.defer(function()
						if isAlive() and not AutoStealToggle.Value then
							pcall(AutoStealToggle.SetValue, AutoStealToggle, true)
						end
					end)
				elseif AutoStealToggle and not AutoStealToggle.Value then
					func38("🔴 Off")
				end

				if func39 then
					func39("inventory-space")
				end
			elseif AutoStealToggle and AutoStealToggle.Value then
				task.defer(handlers.stopAutoStealForFullInventory, value268, value269, "Your egg inventory is full!")
			end
		end)

		if typeof(EggInventory) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
			local chsaeRuntimeConns = getgenv().__CHSAE_RuntimeConns

			if type(chsaeRuntimeConns) == "table" then
				chsaeRuntimeConns[#chsaeRuntimeConns + 1] = EggInventory
			end
		end
	end)
end

						self.pauseCredit = (self.pauseCredit or 0) + n3

						if lastStep - self.registrationWaitAt >= 1.5 or self.pauseSpent >= 3 then
							return false, "movement registration wait expired: " .. str65
						end
						return true
					end

					if self.correctionObserved then
						self.interpolation = self.root.Position
					end

					self.correctionObserved = nil
					self.registrationPending = false
					self.registrationWaitAt = nil
				end

				if (self.root.Position - self.interpolation).Magnitude > 80 then
					return false, "character relocated"
				end
				local n3 = math.min(math.max(0, n2 - 0.1), math.max(0, 8 - (self.frameWaitSpent or 0)))
				self.frameWaitSpent = (self.frameWaitSpent or 0) + n3
				self.pauseCredit = (self.pauseCredit or 0) + n3
				self.deadline = self.deadline + n3
				if magnitude > 0.35 and lastStep >= self.deadline then
					return false, "movement timeout"
				end
				local n4 = magnitude > 0.35 and math.min(self.speed * math.min(n2, 0.1) / magnitude, 1) or 1
				self.root.CFrame = self.root.CFrame:Lerp(self.target, n4)
				self.interpolation = self.root.Position

				if n4 >= 1 then
					local target = self.target
					self.interpolation = nil
					self.holdCFrame = target
				end
			end

			if self.tween then
				local playbackState = self.tween.PlaybackState
				if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled then
					return false, "engine tween cancelled"
				end
				local magnitude = (self.goal - self.root.Position).Magnitude

				if magnitude <= 0.35 then
					self.tween:Cancel()
					self.tween:Destroy()
					self.tween = nil
					self.holdCFrame = self.target
				elseif playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
					self.completedAt = self.completedAt or lastStep

					if math.clamp(n2 * 4 + (self.pingSeconds or 0) * 1.5 + 0.08, 0.16, 0.9) <= lastStep - self.completedAt then
						if not (not self.endpointRecovery and magnitude <= 20) then
							return false, self.endpointRecovery and "tween final approach failed" or "tween ended away from goal"
						end
						self.endpointRecovery = true
						self:startLeg(self.goal, math.clamp(math.min(self.speed, 500), 100, 500))
					end
				elseif self.deadline <= lastStep then
					return false, "movement timeout"
				end
			end

			if not self.tween and self.holdCFrame then
				local n3 = self.root.Position - self.holdCFrame.Position
				local n4 = math.clamp(n2, 0, 0.25)
				local n5 = math.max(3, workspace.Gravity * n4 * n4 + 2)
				if not self.ragdollHold and (math.sqrt(n3.X * n3.X + n3.Z * n3.Z) > 6 or math.abs(n3.Y) > n5) then
					return false, "character relocated during hold"
				end
				self.root.CFrame = self.holdCFrame
			end

			local root = self.root
			self.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			self.humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
			return true
		end

		index.relocate = function(self, param214)

			if self.correctionActive and self.correctionActive() then
				return false
			end
			self:faceGoal(param214)
			self.root.CFrame = self:uprightAt(param214)

			end

			end

		end

	devChickenTween.move = function(goal, flag380, callback5, callback6, callback7, speed, flag381)
		local lease = devChickenTween.lease
		if not lease or not devChickenTween.alive(lease) or flag121.owner ~= lease.owner then
			return false, "Tween rig unavailable"
		end
		local ticket = {}
		speed = speed or handlers.getDeliverySpeed()
		lease.ticket = ticket
		lease.goal = goal
		lease.speed = speed
		local flag382 = false

		local ok, result, result2 = pcall(function()
			if not callback5() or callback7 and callback7() then
				return false, "cancelled"
			end

			if callback6 and callback6() then
				flag382 = true
				return true
			end

			if flag381 and lease.owner == "Steal" then
				lease.mover:returnHome(goal, lease.speed)
			else
				lease.mover:setGoal(goal, lease.speed)
			end

			local stealClaim = handlers.StealClaim

			if lease.owner == "Steal" and stealClaim and stealClaim.movementStarted then
				stealClaim:movementStarted(lease.speed)
			end

			local n2 = (goal - lease.root.Position).Magnitude / lease.speed
			local n3 = os.clock() + n2 + 8

			while devChickenTween.alive(lease) and lease.ticket == ticket do
				lease.lastUse = os.clock()
				if flag121.owner ~= lease.owner or not callback5() or callback7 and callback7() then
					return false, "cancelled"
				end

				if callback6 and callback6() then
					flag382 = true
					return true
				end

				if (lease.root.Position - goal).Magnitude <= (flag380 or 0.35) then
					return true
				end

				if n3 <= os.clock() then
					return false, "movement timeout"
				end
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end

			return false, lease.stopReason or "Tween interrupted"
		end)

		if devChickenTween.lease == lease and lease.ticket == ticket and not lease.cancelled then
			devChickenTween.stopTween(lease, ok and result == true and not flag382)
		end

		if not ok then
			devChickenTween.restore("Tween error")
			return false, tostring(result)
		end

	end

			end,
			held = function()

			end,
			claimed = function()

				return flag403 == nil or tostring(flag403.State) == "Claimed"
			end,
			alive = function()
				return isAlive() and callback10() and localPlayer.Character == character and humanoid5.Health > 0 and not func43()

			finish = function(flag404, param249)

				if devChickenTween2.lease then
					devChickenTween2.restore(flag404 and "steal complete" or "steal ended")
				end

				if flag404 then
					num15.carriedUid = nil
				end

			end,
			grab = function()
				for i = 1, 30 do
					local flag405 = flag401.record()
					if not (flag405 and flag401.alive()) then
						return false
					end

				end

			end,
			needsStart = function(num49)

				end

				return flag406 and ((result40.Position - num49) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude > 2
			end,
			walkToStart = function(param250)
				if not flag401.needsStart(param250) then
					return true
				end
				func38("Going to start")

				local flag407, flag408 = handlers.walkTo(param250, function()
					return flag401.alive() and flag401.record() ~= nil
				end, 1.5)

			returnHome = function(param251, flag409)

					else
						flag410 = result41
					end

						return flag401.finish(false, "could not return to start")
					end

					if not devChickenTween2.move(param251, 0.6, func212, flag401.claimed, nil, value317, true) and not flag401.claimed() then

				end

		}

	end

	local vector = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

	local function func213(param252)
		local tbl102 = {
			root = nil,
			support = nil,
			height = nil,
			reason = "idle",
			Stop = function(param253)
				if param253.support then
					param252.destroy(param253.support)
				end

				param253.root = nil
				param253.support = nil
				param253.height = nil
			end,
			Step = function(obj37, root, flag411, height)
				if not flag411 or not root or type(height) ~= "number" or height ~= height or math.abs(height) == math.huge then
					obj37.reason = "flight prerequisites"
					obj37:Stop()
					return false
				end

				if obj37.root ~= root then
					obj37:Stop()
				end

				local num50, num51, num52 = param252.sample(root)
				local flag412 = num52 <= 0 or num52 == math.huge or num52 ~= num52

				if not flag412 then
					flag412 = num51.Magnitude > math.max(500, param252.speed or 0) * 1.2
				end

				if flag412 then
					obj37.reason = "rig physics settling"
					obj37:Stop()
					return false
				end

				local n2 = param252.goal(root, height) - num50
				local flag413 = n2.Magnitude > 0.15

				if flag413 then
					flag413 = n2.Unit * math.min(param252.speed or 500, n2.Magnitude * (param252.gain or 8))
				end

				local vector2 = flag413 or Vector3.zero
				local flag414, value318, flag415 = param252.register(root, vector2, num52 * (vector2 - num51))

				if not flag414 then
					obj37.reason = flag415 or "movement registration unavailable"

					if flag415 == "renewing" and obj37.support then
						if param252.pause then
							param252.pause(obj37.support)
						end

						return true
					end

					obj37:Stop()
					return false
				end

				obj37.reason = nil
				obj37.root = root
				obj37.height = height

				if not obj37.support then
					obj37.support = param252.create(root)
				end

				param252.update(obj37.support, vector2, num52)
				return true
			end,
		}

		tbl102.Destroy = tbl102.Stop
		tbl102.Disconnect = tbl102.Stop
		return tbl102
	end

	local tbl103 = {
		sample = function(part3)
			return part3.Position, part3.AssemblyLinearVelocity, part3.Anchored and math.huge or part3.AssemblyMass
		end,
		register = function(part4, param254, param255)
			if param254.Magnitude <= 0 then
				return func140(part4, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), 1, 0.5, param255, false)
			end
			local unit = param254.Unit
			local value319 = flag187 and flag187.state and rawget(flag187.state, "ImpulseContext")
			local originPosition = type(value319) == "table" and value319.OriginPosition
			local flag416 = type(value319) == "table" and tonumber(value319.MaxVerticalSpeed)
			local flag417 = type(value319) == "table" and tonumber(value319.MaxUpwardDistance)
			local flag418 = typeof(originPosition) == "Vector3" and flag416 and flag417 and math.abs(param254.Y) + 5 <= flag416 and part4.Position.Y - originPosition.Y + math.max(0, param254.Y) * 0.05 + 2 < flag417
			return func140(part4, unit, math.max(1, param254.Magnitude), 24, param255, not flag418)
		end,
		pause = function(param256)
			if param256.active then
				param256.velocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
			end
		end,
		create = function(parent)
			local parent2 = parent.Parent
			local humanoid = parent2 and parent2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			assert(humanoid, "flight Humanoid unavailable")
			local tbl104 = { root = parent, humanoid = humanoid, platformStand = humanoid.PlatformStand, active = true, collisions = {} }

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				tbl104.velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				tbl104.velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				tbl104.velocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
				tbl104.gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
				tbl104.gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				tbl104.gyro.D = 100
				tbl104.gyro.P = 10000
				tbl104.gyro.CFrame = parent.CFrame

				local function func214(descendant)
					if tbl104.active and descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant:IsDescendantOf(parent2) and tbl104.collisions[descendant] == nil then
						tbl104.collisions[descendant] = descendant.CanCollide
					end
				end

				tbl104.partAdded = parent2.DescendantAdded:Connect(func214)

				tbl104.partRemoving = parent2.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(descendant)
					if not tbl104.active then
						return
					end
					local flag419 = tbl104.collisions[descendant]

					if flag419 ~= nil then
						tbl104.collisions[descendant] = nil

						pcall(function()
							descendant.CanCollide = flag419
						end)
					end
				end)

				for _, queryDescendant3 in ipairs(parent2:QueryDescendants("BasePart")) do
					func214(queryDescendant3)
				end

				tbl104.velocity.Parent = parent
				tbl104.gyro.Parent = parent
				humanoid.PlatformStand = true
			end)

			if not ok then
				tbl104.active = false

				if tbl104.partAdded then
					tbl104.partAdded:Disconnect()
				end

				if tbl104.partRemoving then
					tbl104.partRemoving:Disconnect()
				end

				table.clear(tbl104.collisions)

				if tbl104.velocity then
					tbl104.velocity:Destroy()
				end

				if tbl104.gyro then
					tbl104.gyro:Destroy()
				end

				humanoid.PlatformStand = tbl104.platformStand
				error(result)
			end

			return tbl104
		end,
		update = function(list42, velocity)
			if not list42.active then
				return
			end

			for k in pairs(list42.collisions) do
				if k.CanCollide then
					k.CanCollide = false
				end
			end

			list42.velocity.Velocity = velocity
			local n2 = velocity * vector

			if n2.Magnitude > 0.15 then
				list42.gyro.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(list42.root.Position, list42.root.Position + n2)
			end
		end,
		destroy = function(list43)
			if not list43.active then
				return
			end
			list43.active = false
			list43.partAdded:Disconnect()
			list43.partRemoving:Disconnect()

			for k, collision in pairs(list43.collisions) do
				pcall(function()
					k.CanCollide = collision
				end)
			end

			table.clear(list43.collisions)
			list43.velocity:Destroy()
			list43.gyro:Destroy()
			list43.humanoid.PlatformStand = list43.platformStand
		end,
	}

	handlers.flyDropPoint = function(obj, childName)
		local world = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS")

		-- deobfuscated by 𝐒𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐜𝐞 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐤 (𝐒𝐋) -> https://discord.gg/x7YbZeezpm

		local value321 = nil

				local position2 = child:GetPivot().Position
				local magnitude = ((position2 - position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude

				if not value321 or magnitude < value321 then
					value321 = magnitude
					value322 = position2
				end
			end
		end

		local value323 = nil
		local value324 = nil

		for i = 1, 12 do
			local n2 = math.random() * 3.1415926535897931 * 2
			local n3 = math.sqrt(math.random()) * 6
			local y = obj.Y
			local z = value322.Z
			local vector2 = Vector3.new(value322.X + math.cos(n2) * n3, y, z + math.sin(n2) * n3)
			local flag420 = handlers.playerGap(vector2)

			if not value323 or flag420 > value323 then

				value324 = vector2

		end

	end

	handlers.flyTo = function(obj, callback11, flag421)

		end

	end

	handlers.relayReturn = function(obj, num57, num58, callback12)
		local devChickenTween2 = handlers.DevChickenTween
		local num59, value326 = func125()
		if not (num59 and value326) then
			return obj.finish(false, "character unavailable")
		end
		local n2 = value326.HipHeight + num59.Size.Y / 2
		local n3 = num58 + Vector3.new(0, 46 - n2, 0)

		local function func215()
			return obj.alive() and devChickenTween2.lease ~= nil and devChickenTween2.alive(devChickenTween2.lease)
		end

		local function func216()
			local flag424 = obj.record()
			return func215() and flag424 ~= nil and flag424.State == "Dropped"
		end

		for i = 1, 10 do
			if not func215() then
				return obj.finish(false, "cancelled")
			end
			func38(callback12 and ("⚡ Hop Fly %d · dropping at the drop spot"):format(i) or ("🔁 Relay %d · dropping in Desert"):format(i))
			local lease = devChickenTween2.lease

				return obj.finish(false, "relay teleport: " .. tostring(value327))
			end
			task.wait(0.12)
			if not func215() then
				return obj.finish(false, "cancelled")
			end
			local ok = pcall(tbl47.DropAreaEgg, "PlayerRequest")
			local flag426, value328 = lease.mover:teleportTo(position, 2000, flag187)
			devChickenTween2.stopTween(lease, false)
			if not flag426 then
				return obj.finish(false, "relay return: " .. tostring(value328))
			end

			if not ok then
				return obj.finish(false, "drop request failed")
			end
			local n4 = os.clock() + 2
			local flag427 = obj.record()

			while os.clock() < n4 and func215() and (obj.held() or not flag427 or flag427.State ~= "Dropped") do
				task.wait(0.03)
				flag427 = obj.record()
			end

			if not func215() then
				return obj.finish(false, "cancelled")
			end

			if obj.held() then
				return obj.finish(false, "drop rejected")
			end

			if not flag427 then
				return obj.finish(false, "dropped egg unavailable")
			end

			if flag427.State ~= "Dropped" then
				return obj.finish(false, "egg returned to its nest")
			end
			critical = false
			task.wait(0.2)
			local flag428 = obj.record()
			if not (flag428 and flag428.State == "Dropped") then
				return obj.finish(false, "egg returned to its nest")
			end
			local n5 = flag428.BottomCFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, n2, 0)

			if callback12 then
				func38("⚡ Hopping to the dropped egg")

				for _, item63 in ipairs(handlers.flyPath(num59.Position, n5, 370, n5.Y + 42)) do
					if not func216() then
						return obj.finish(false, "could not reach dropped egg")
					end
					local flag429, value329 = callback12(item63)
					if not flag429 then
						return obj.finish(false, "hop: " .. tostring(value329))
					end
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			else
				func38("🔁 Relay · tweening to dropped egg")

				end

				if not devChickenTween2.move(n5, 0.6, func216, nil, nil, 2000, true) then
					return obj.finish(false, "could not reach dropped egg")
				end
			end

			if not obj.grab() then
				return obj.finish(false, "re-pickup rejected")
			end
			local n6 = os.clock() + 2

			while os.clock() < n6 and func215() and not obj.held() do
				task.wait(0.03)
			end

			if not func215() then
				return obj.finish(false, "cancelled")
			end

				return obj.finish(false, "carry not confirmed")
			end

				return obj.returnHome(num57)
			end

			if not callback12 and func47(n5) == "Desert" then
				return obj.returnHome(num57, true)
			end
		end

		return obj.finish(false, "relay limit reached")
	end

	handlers.runFlySteal = function(carriedUid, callback13, param258, param259, param260)

AutoStealToggle:OnChanged(function(autoSteal)
	local automaticStealStop2 = handlers.automaticStealStop == true
	handlers.automaticStealStop = nil
	tbl9.AutoSteal = autoSteal

	if func39 then
		func39(autoSteal and "enabled" or "disabled")
	end

	if tbl9.Stall then
		return
	end

	if autoSteal then
		local value412, value413, value414 = handlers.eggInventoryCapacityState()

		if value412 then
			tbl9.AutoSteal = false
			task.defer(handlers.stopAutoStealForFullInventory, value413, value414, "Your egg inventory is full!")
			return
		end

		handlers.inventoryFullStopped = false
		func1(true)
		func38("🟡 Waiting for target")
	else
		if handlers.greatBloomUnlockNeedsCrane() then
			func38("🔓 Great Bloom · finding Crane egg")

			if func39 then
				func39("great-bloom-unlock")
			end

			return
		end

		func1(false)
		func40()
		local chsaeCarryRequest = getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest

		if type(chsaeCarryRequest) == "table" and chsaeCarryRequest.inFlight ~= true then
			getgenv().__CHSAE_CarryRequest = nil
		end

		local value415 = flag121
		flag121.stealWants = false
		value415.critical = false
		flag121.release("Steal")
		handlers.pauseStealTimer()
		handlers.set("target", "🎯 Target: none")
		handlers.carry = "📦 Carry: none"
		handlers.activeGuardAreaId = nil
		func42()
		if automaticStealStop2 then
			return
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait()
			if not isAlive() or tbl9.Stall or tbl9.AutoSteal or critical then
				return
			end
			local num64 = handlers.getStealStart()
			local flag535, flag536 = func125()
			if not (num64 and flag535 and flag536 and flag536.Health > 0) then
				return
			end

			if ((flag535.Position - num64.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude <= 3 then
				return
			end
			flag121.stealWants = true

			if flag121.acquireWait("Steal", 1) then
				func38("↩️ Returning to start")

				handlers.settleClaimAtTrackStart(function()
					return isAlive() and not tbl9.Stall and not tbl9.AutoSteal and not critical and flag121.hold("Steal")
				end, num64)

				flag121.release("Steal")
			end

			flag121.stealWants = false
			func42()
		end)
	end
end)

	local function func304(flag654)
		if not handlers.sellerValueFilterReady("SellPetValueThreshold") then
			setStatus2("⏸️ Finish editing value")
			return 0, false, 0
		end
		local flag655, flag656, flag657, flag658, value534 = filterState2()
		if not (flag655 or flag656 or flag657 or flag658 or value534) then
			setStatus2("🟡 Pick a filter")
			return 0, false, 0
		end
		local result61 = matching2()
		if #result61 == 0 then
			setStatus2("🟢 Armed · 0 match")
			return 0, false, 0
		end
		local value535, value536, flag659, flag660, flag661 = func300(result61, nil, flag654)
		if flag661 == "preflight-empty" then
			setStatus2("🟢 Armed · 0 verified")
			return 0, false, 0
		end

		if flag661 == "value-input-mismatch" then
			setStatus2("⏸️ Visible value does not match saved value")
			return 0, true, 0
		end

		if flag661 == "seller-busy" then
			setStatus2(handlers.hatchPetSaleGuardActive() and "⏸️ Fresh/held hatch pet protected" or "⏸️ Busy · retrying")
			return 0, true, 0
		end

		if flag661 == "save-unavailable" then
			setStatus2("⏸️ Inventory unavailable · retrying")
			return 0, true, 0
		end

		if flag661 == "confirmation-unavailable" then
			setStatus2("🔴 Seller stopped · confirmation unavailable")
			return 0, false, flag659
		end

		if flag661 == "transport-error" then
			setStatus2("🔴 Sell request failed")
			return 0, true, flag659
		end

		if (flag660 or 0) > 0 then
			setStatus2("🔴 Seller stopped · unexpected inventory change")
		elseif not flag654 or tbl9[flag654] then
			setStatus2(flag659 > 0 and ("🟡 Sold %d · %d not sold"):format(value535, flag659) or ("🟢 Sold %d · $%s"):format(value535, func10(value536)))
		end

		return value535, true, flag659
	end

	handlers.sellerToggle = function(obj, str105, str106)
		local addToggle = nil

		local function func305(param308)
			handlers[str105.writeFlag] = true
			tbl9[str106.key] = param308

			local ok = pcall(function()
				addToggle:SetValue(param308)
			end)

			handlers[str105.writeFlag] = nil
			return ok
		end

		addToggle = obj.AddToggle
		addToggle = addToggle(obj, str106.id, { Text = str106.text, Default = tbl9[str106.key], Risky = true, Tooltip = str106.tooltip })

		addToggle:OnChanged(function(flag662)
			if handlers[str105.writeFlag] == true then
				return
			end

			if not flag662 then
				tbl9[str106.key] = false

				if str105.refresh then
					str105.refresh()
				end

				if str106.full then
					str105.setStatus(tbl9[str105.autoKey] and str105.armedText or "🔴 Off")
				elseif not tbl9[str105.fullKey] then
					str105.setStatus("🔴 Off")
				end

				return
			end

			func305(false)
			if handlers.valueFilterLoadInProgress == true then
				return
			end

			if not handlers.sellerValueFilterReady(str105.valueKey) then
				str105.setStatus("⏸️ Finish editing value")
				lua:Notify("Finish editing Minimum Value, then enable " .. str106.label .. " again.", 4)
				return
			end

			if not handlers.sellerHasFilter(str105) then

	local function func306(flag673)

					if ok and result then

			end
		end)

	end

	local function matching3(flag676)
		local flag677, flag678, flag679, flag680, flag681 = filterState3()
		local list72 = {}

		if not (flag678 or flag677 or flag679 or flag680 or flag681) then
			handlers.riftEggBlocked = 0
			func308(0, 0, false)
			return list72, 0, 0, 0
		end

		local tbl154 = {}
		local flag682 = false
		local flag683 = false

		if type(handlers.getAutoPlaceEggPolicy) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				local value548, value549, value550 = handlers.getAutoPlaceEggPolicy()
				tbl154 = value548
				flag682 = value549
				flag683 = value550
			end)
		end

		local n2 = 0
		local n3 = 0
		local riftEggBlocked = 0
		local n4 = 0

		for _, item90 in ipairs(func306(flag676)) do
			local category = item90.item.Category
			local flag684 = func292(item90.item)
			local flag685 = not flag677 or tbl9.SellEggNames[category] == true
			local flag686 = not flag678 or flag684 and tbl9.SellEggRarities[flag684._id] == true
			local flag687 = not flag679
			local flag688 = not flag680 or handlers.kgFilterMatches(item90.item, tbl9.SellEggKGMode, tbl9.SellEggKGThreshold)
			local flag689 = not flag681 or handlers.valueFilterMatches(item90.income, tbl9.SellEggValueThreshold, "below", item90.incomeKnown)

			if flag679 then
				for _, item91 in ipairs(func293(item90.item)) do
					if tbl9.SellEggMutations[item91] then
						flag687 = true
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if flag685 and flag686 and flag687 and flag688 and flag689 then
				local flag690 = tbl154[tostring(item90.uid)] == true
				local value551 = handlers.labEggReserved(item90.uid, item90.category) or handlers.petIndexReserved(item90.uid)

				if flag690 or value551 then
					n2 = n2 + (1)
				end

				if value551 then
					n3 = n3 + (1)
					riftEggBlocked = riftEggBlocked + (1)
				elseif flag690 then
					list72[#list72 + 1] = item90
					n4 = n4 + (item90.price or 0)
				else
					list72[#list72 + 1] = item90
					n4 = n4 + (item90.price or 0)
				end
			end
		end

		if not flag676 then
			handlers.riftEggBlocked = riftEggBlocked
			func308(n2, n3, flag683)
		end

			return tostring(param319.uid) < tostring(param320.uid)
		end)

		return list72, n4, n2, n3
	end

	local function func310(list73, num76, param322)
		local function func311(list74, flag691, flag692)
			local function func312()
				local SellEggValueThreshold = isAlive() and not critical and flag121.sellOk() and handlers.sellerValueFilterReady("SellEggValueThreshold")
				local flag693

				if SellEggValueThreshold then
					flag693 = not flag692 or tbl9[flag692] == true
				else
					flag693 = SellEggValueThreshold
				end

				return flag693
			end

			if not func312() then
				return 0, 0, 0
			end

			if not (petSatchel and petSatchel.SellPet and tbl47 and tbl47.RequestEquipTool) then
				return 0, 0, #list74
			end
			local tbl156 = {}
			local tbl157 = {}
			local tbl158 = {}
			local tbl159 = {}

			for _, item92 in ipairs(list74) do
				tbl156[tostring(item92.uid)] = true
			end

			for _, item93 in ipairs(matching3(tbl156)) do
				local str109 = tostring(item93.uid)

				if tbl156[str109] and not tbl159[str109] and not handlers.labEggReserved(str109) and not handlers.petIndexReserved(str109) then
					if not (flag691 and #tbl158 >= flag691) then
						local n2 = #tbl157 + 1
						local n3 = #tbl158 + 1
						tbl157[n2] = item93
						tbl158[n3] = str109
						tbl159[str109] = true
						continue
					end
				else
					continue
				end

				break
			end

			if #tbl158 == 0 or not func312() then
				return 0, 0, 0
			end

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return flag540.Get()
			end)

			if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.EggInventory) ~= "table" then
				return 0, 0, #tbl157
			end
			local tbl160 = {}

			for k in pairs(result.EggInventory) do
				tbl160[tostring(k)] = true
			end

			local tbl161 = {}

			for _, item94 in ipairs(matching3(tbl156)) do
				tbl161[tostring(item94.uid)] = item94
			end

			local tbl162 = {}
			local tbl163 = {}
			table.clear(tbl159)

			for _, item95 in ipairs(tbl158) do
				if tbl160[item95] and tbl161[item95] and not handlers.labEggReserved(item95) and not handlers.petIndexReserved(item95) then
					local n2 = #tbl162 + 1
					local n3 = #tbl163 + 1
					tbl162[n2] = tbl161[item95]
					tbl163[n3] = item95
					tbl159[item95] = true
				end
			end

			if #tbl163 == 0 or not func312() then
				return 0, 0, 0
			end
			local first6 = tbl163[1]
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			if not character then
				return 0, 0, #tbl162
			end
			handlers.sellerEggUid = first6
			handlers.sellerUsedTool = true
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(tbl47.RequestEquipTool, first6)
			if not ok2 or result2 ~= true then
				return 0, 0, #tbl162
			end
			local n2 = os.clock() + 1.5
			local tool

			while true do
				tool = nil

				if localPlayer.Character ~= character then
					break
				else
					tool = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

					if tool and tool:GetAttribute("ItemType") == "AssetEgg" and tool:GetAttribute("UID") == first6 then
						handlers.sellerHeldTool = tool
						break
					else
						local flag694 = not func312() or os.clock() >= n2
						tool = nil
						if not flag694 then
							task.wait(0.05)
							continue
						end
					end

					break
				end
			end

			if not tool then
				return 0, 0, #tbl162
			end
			local flag695 = false

			for _, item96 in ipairs(matching3({ [first6] = true })) do
				if tostring(item96.uid) == first6 and not handlers.labEggReserved(first6) and not handlers.petIndexReserved(first6) then
					flag695 = true
					break
				end
			end

			if not flag695 or not func312() or localPlayer.Character ~= character or character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool") ~= tool or tool:GetAttribute("ItemType") ~= "AssetEgg" or tool:GetAttribute("UID") ~= first6 then
				return 0, 0, 0
			end

			if not pcall(function()
				petSatchel.SellPet:FireServer({ first6 })
			end) then
				return 0, 0, #tbl162
			end
			local n3 = os.clock() + 2.5
			local eggInventory

			while true do
				local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
					return flag540.Get()
				end)

				local flag696 = ok3 and type(result3) == "table" and type(result3.EggInventory) == "table"
				eggInventory = nil

				if flag696 then
					eggInventory = result3.EggInventory
					local flag697 = true

					for _, item97 in ipairs(tbl163) do
						if eggInventory[item97] ~= nil then
							flag697 = false
							break
						end
					end

					if not flag697 then
						if not (n3 <= os.clock()) then
							task.wait(0.1)
							continue
						end
					end
				elseif not (n3 <= os.clock()) then
					task.wait(0.1)
					continue
				end

				break
			end

			if eggInventory then
				task.wait(0.25)

				local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
					return flag540.Get()
				end)

				eggInventory = ok3 and type(result3) == "table" and type(result3.EggInventory) == "table" and result3.EggInventory or nil
			end

			if not eggInventory then
				handlers.forceDisarmEggSeller("🔴 Seller stopped · confirmation unavailable", "Egg selling stopped because the batch result could not be verified.", true)
				return 0, 0, #tbl162, "confirmation-unavailable"
			end
			local n4 = 0
			local n5 = 0

			for _, item98 in ipairs(tbl162) do
				if eggInventory[tostring(item98.uid)] == nil then
					n4 = n4 + (1)
					n5 = n5 + (item98.price or 0)
				end
			end

			for k in pairs(tbl160) do
				if not tbl159[k] and eggInventory[k] == nil then
					handlers.forceDisarmEggSeller("🔴 Seller stopped · unexpected inventory change", "Egg selling stopped because an egg outside the filtered batch disappeared.", true)
					return n4, n5, #tbl162 - n4, "unexpected-removal"
				end
			end

			return n4, n5, #tbl162 - n4
		end

		if #list73 <= 1 then
			local packed8 = table.pack(func311(list73, num76, param322))
			handlers.stopHoldingSellerTool()
			return table.unpack(packed8, 1, packed8.n)
		end

		local tbl164 = {}
		local n2 = 1
		local n3 = 0
		local n4 = 0
		local n5 = 0
		local n6 = 0
		local value553

		while true do
			if not (n2 <= #list73) then
				return n4, n5, n6
			else
				local n7 = num76 and math.max(0, num76 - n3) or 1
				if n7 <= 0 then
					return n4, n5, n6
				end
				local list75 = {}

				while n2 <= #list73 and #list75 < math.min(1, n7) do
					local entry29 = list73[n2]
					n2 = n2 + (1)
					local str110 = tostring(entry29.uid or "")

					if str110 ~= "" and not tbl164[str110] then
						tbl164[str110] = true
						list75[#list75 + 1] = entry29
					end
				end

				if #list75 > 0 then
					local num77, value554, num78
					num77, value554, num78, value553 = func311(list75, n7, param322)
					handlers.stopHoldingSellerTool()
					n4 = n4 + (num77)
					n5 = n5 + (value554)
					n6 = n6 + (num78)
					n3 = n3 + (num77 + num78)
					if value553 then
						break
					end

					if num78 > 0 or tbl9.AutoTreadmill and not flag121.treadmillTraining then
						return n4, n5, n6
					end
				end

				if n2 <= #list73 then
					task.wait()
				end
			end
		end

		return n4, n5, n6, value553
	end

handlers.createFuseController = function(obj)
	local function func314(flag714)
		return type(flag714) == "number" and flag714 == flag714 and flag714 >= 0 and flag714 < math.huge
	end

	local flag715

	flag715 = {
		owned = {},
		pending = nil,
		status = "Off",
		completed = 0,
		eligible = function(param324, param325, param326, param327)
			local settings_2 = obj.settings
			if type(param325) ~= "table" or settings_2.FuseCategories[param325.Category] ~= true then
				return false
			end
			local flag716 = not func314(settings_2.FuseMinimumValue) or not func314(settings_2.FuseKGThreshold)

			if not flag716 then
				flag716 = settings_2.FuseKGMode ~= "Any" and settings_2.FuseKGMode ~= "Above" and settings_2.FuseKGMode ~= "Below"
			end

			if flag716 then
				return false
			end

			if param325.IsFavorite == true or param325.InFuse == true ~= param327 then
				return false
			end
			local func315 = pairs
			local equippedAssets = param326.EquippedAssets or {}

			for _, equippedAsset in func315(equippedAssets) do
				if tostring(equippedAsset) == tostring(param324) then
					return false
				end
			end

			if obj.protected(param324, param326) then
				return false
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(obj.mayEnter, param324, param325, nil, param327)
			if not ok or result ~= true then
				return false
			end
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(obj.decode, param325)
			if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" then
				return false
			end

			if settings_2.FuseKGMode ~= "Any" and settings_2.FuseKGThreshold > 0 then
				local value572 = obj.weight(result2)
				if not func314(value572) or obj.kgMatches(value572, settings_2.FuseKGMode, settings_2.FuseKGThreshold, true) then
					return false
				end
			end

			if settings_2.FuseMinimumValue > 0 then
				local value573, flag717 = obj.value(result2)
				if not flag717 or not func314(value573) or value573 >= settings_2.FuseMinimumValue then
					return false
				end
			end

			return true, result2
		end,
		plan = function(list76)
			if type(list76) ~= "table" or type(list76.Inventory) ~= "table" or type(list76.FusionSlots) ~= "table" then
				return nil, "Waiting for fuse data"
			end
			local list77 = {}
			local tbl165 = {}
			local value574 = nil

			for i = 1, 3 do
				local value575 = list76.FusionSlots[i]

				if value575 then
					if tbl165[value575] or not flag715.owned[value575] then
						return nil, "Machine has manually loaded pets"
					end
					tbl165[value575] = true
					local value576 = list76.Inventory[value575]
					if not flag715.eligible(value575, value576, list76, true) then
						return nil, "Returning a protected pet", value575
					end
					value574 = value574 and value576.Category ~= value574
					if value574 then
						return nil, "Returning mismatched pet", value575
					end
					value574 = value576.Category
					list77[#list77 + 1] = value575
				end
			end

			local tbl166 = {}

			if value574 then
				tbl166[value574] = table.clone(list77)
			end

			for k, value577 in pairs(list76.Inventory) do
				if not tbl165[k] and (not value574 or value577.Category == value574) and flag715.eligible(k, value577, list76, false) then
					tbl166[value577.Category] = tbl166[value577.Category] or {}
					table.insert(tbl166[value577.Category], k)
				end
			end

			local list78 = {}

			for k, value578 in pairs(tbl166) do
				if #value578 >= 3 then
					list78[#list78 + 1] = k
				end
			end

			table.sort(list78)
			if #list78 == 0 then
				return nil, "Waiting for 3 eligible pets of one category"
			end
			local list79 = {}

			for _, item99 in ipairs(tbl166[list78[1]]) do
				if not tbl165[item99] then
					list79[#list79 + 1] = item99
				end
			end

			table.sort(list79, function(param328, param329)
				return tostring(param328) < tostring(param329)
			end)

			local list80 = table.clone(list77)

			for _, item100 in ipairs(list79) do
				if #list80 ~= 3 then
					list80[#list80 + 1] = item100
					continue
				end
				break
			end

			return { uids = list80, loaded = #list77, category = list78[1] }, "Ready"
		end,
		tick = function()
			if not obj.alive() then
				return
			end

			if not obj.idle() then
				flag715.status = "Waiting for idle time"
				return
			end

			if not obj.ready() then
				flag715.status = "Waiting for filter edits to finish"
				return
			end
			local flag718 = obj.save()
			if type(flag718) ~= "table" or type(flag718.FusionSlots) ~= "table" then
				flag715.status = "Waiting for fuse data"
				return
			end

			if flag715.pending then
				local pending = flag715.pending
				local action2 = pending.action == "BeginFuse" and pending.uids ~= nil

				if action2 then
					for _, uid in ipairs(pending.uids) do
						if flag718.Inventory[uid] then
							action2 = false
							break
						end
					end
				end

				local action3 = pending.action == "LoadPet" and flag718.Inventory[pending.uid] and flag718.Inventory[pending.uid].InFuse == true
				local flag719

				if action3 then
					flag719 = action3
				else
					local action4 = pending.action == "EjectPet"

					if action4 then
						flag719 = not flag718.Inventory[pending.uid] or not flag718.Inventory[pending.uid].InFuse
					else
						flag719 = action4
					end
				end

				local flag720 = not (flag719 or pending.action == "BeginFuse" and (flag718.FusionLocked == true or type(flag718.FusionEggReward) == "table" or action2) or pending.action == "FinishReveal" and flag718.FusionEggReward == false)
				local flag721

				if flag720 then
					local at = pending.at
					flag721 = obj.now() - at < 8
				else
					flag721 = flag720
				end

				if flag721 then
					flag715.status = "Waiting for machine confirmation"
					return
				end

				if flag720 then
					obj.disable()
					flag715.status = "Machine confirmation timed out; Auto Fuse stopped"
					flag715.pending = nil
					return
				end

				flag715.pending = nil
			end

			if flag718.FusionEggReward ~= false and flag718.FusionEggReward ~= nil then
				if not obj.settings.AutoFuse then
					flag715.status = "Reward waiting in machine"
					return
				end

				if type(flag718.FusionEndsAt) == "number" and flag718.FusionEndsAt > obj.serverNow() then
					flag715.status = "Fusing"
					return
				end
				flag715.status = "Claiming fused egg"
				flag715.pending = { action = "FinishReveal", at = obj.now() }
				local FinishReveal, flag722 = obj.request("FinishReveal")

				if FinishReveal == false then
					flag715.pending = nil
					flag715.status = tostring(flag722 or "Reward not ready")
				end

				return
			end

			if flag718.FusionLocked == true then
				flag715.status = "Fusing"
				return
			end
			local tbl167 = {}

			for _, fusionSlot in pairs(flag718.FusionSlots) do
				if fusionSlot then
					tbl167[fusionSlot] = true
				end
			end

			for k in pairs(flag715.owned) do
				if not tbl167[k] then
					flag715.owned[k] = nil
				end
			end

			local str111, value579, flag723 = flag715.plan(flag718)

			if not obj.settings.AutoFuse then
				local value580, value581, value582 = pairs(flag715.owned)
				local packed9 = table.pack(V_1())

				if packed9[1] then
					flag723 = packed9[2]
				end

				if not flag723 then
					flag715.status = "Off"
					return
				end
			end

			if flag723 then
				flag715.status = "Returning protected/unused pet"
				flag715.pending = { action = "EjectPet", uid = flag723, at = obj.now() }
				local EjectPet, flag724 = obj.request("EjectPet", flag723)

				if EjectPet == false then
					flag715.pending = nil
					flag715.status = tostring(flag724 or "Cannot return pet")
				end

				return
			end

			if not str111 then
				flag715.status = value579
				return
			end
			local flag725, value583, flag726 = obj.capacity()
			if flag725 or not flag726 then
				flag715.status = "Waiting for egg inventory space"
				return
			end
			local value584 = obj.price(flag718, str111.uids)
			if not func314(value584) or not func314(flag718.Money) or flag718.Money < value584 then
				flag715.status = "Waiting for fuse cost"
				return
			end

			if not obj.alive() or not obj.settings.AutoFuse or not obj.idle() or not obj.ready() then
				return
			end

			if str111.loaded < 3 then
				local num79 = str111.uids[str111.loaded + 1]
				local value585 = obj.save()
				local flag727 = flag715.plan(value585)
				if not flag727 or flag727.uids[flag727.loaded + 1] ~= num79 or flag727.loaded ~= str111.loaded then
					return
				end
				flag715.owned[num79] = true
				flag715.pending = { action = "LoadPet", uid = num79, at = obj.now() }
				flag715.status = "Loading " .. str111.category .. " (" .. tostring(str111.loaded + 1) .. "/3)"
				local LoadPet, flag728 = obj.request("LoadPet", num79)

				if LoadPet == false then
					flag715.pending = nil
					flag715.owned[num79] = nil
					flag715.status = tostring(flag728 or "Pet rejected")
				end
			else
				local value586 = obj.save()
				local flag729 = flag715.plan(value586)
				if not flag729 or flag729.loaded ~= 3 or value586.FusionLocked ~= false or value586.FusionEggReward ~= false then
					return
				end

				for i, uid in ipairs(str111.uids) do
					if flag729.uids[i] ~= uid then
						return
					end
				end

				if not obj.settings.AutoFuse or not obj.idle() or not obj.ready() then
					return
				end
				flag715.status = "Fusing " .. str111.category
				flag715.pending = { action = "BeginFuse", at = obj.now(), uids = table.clone(str111.uids) }
				local BeginFuse, flag730 = obj.request("BeginFuse")

				if BeginFuse == false then
					flag715.pending = nil
					flag715.status = tostring(flag730 or "Fuse rejected")
				elseif BeginFuse == true then
					flag715.completed = flag715.completed + 1
				end
			end
		end,
	}

	return flag715
end

local function func316()
	local obj56 = obj1.__FuseTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Auto Fuse")
	obj1.__FuseBox = obj56
	local FuseStatus = nil

	chk.Merge(obj56, function()
		FuseStatus = obj56:AddLabel("FuseStatus", { Text = "Off", DoesWrap = true })
	end)

	handlers.swapBatSwing = function(obj, obj59, callback14)
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if not character or not backpack then
			return nil
		end
		local serverTimeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		obj.batReadyAt = obj.batReadyAt or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		obj.batLastUsed = obj.batLastUsed or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

		if not obj.batClientCooldown then
			obj.batClientCooldown = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Flags.GameplayBalance).BatClient.CLIENT_COOLDOWN
		end

		if serverTimeNow < (obj.nextBatAttack or 0) then
			return "wait"
		end
		local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		local n2 = 0
		local value641 = nil

		for _, item105 in ipairs({ character, backpack }) do
			for _, child in ipairs(item105:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Tool") and (child:GetAttribute("IsBat") == true or child:GetAttribute("GearName") == "Flyswatter" or child:GetAttribute("GearName") == "The Scrambler") then
					n2 = n2 + (1)
					local flag764 = child ~= obj.lastBat

					if flag764 then
						flag764 = serverTimeNow >= (obj.batReadyAt[child] or 0)
					end

					flag764 = flag764 and child.Enabled and child:GetAttribute("CooldownActive") ~= true

					if flag764 then
						flag764 = serverTimeNow >= (tonumber(child:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0)
					end

					if flag764 then
						local flag765 = not value641
						local flag766

						if flag765 then
							flag766 = flag765
						else
							flag766 = (obj.batLastUsed[child] or -math.huge) < (obj.batLastUsed[value641] or -math.huge)
						end

						if flag766 then
							value641 = child
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if n2 < 2 then
			return "single"
		end

		if not value641 then
			return "cooldown"
		end

		if value641 ~= tool then
			obj59:EquipTool(value641)
			obj.bat = value641
			obj.nextBatAttack = serverTimeNow + 0.15
			return "equip"
		end

		obj.nextBatAttack = serverTimeNow + 0.15
		local flag767 = value641:GetAttribute("IsBat") ~= true and (value641:GetAttribute("GearName") == "Flyswatter" or value641:GetAttribute("GearName") == "The Scrambler")
		if not callback14(value641, flag767) then
			return "blocked"
		end
		local trigger = nil

		if flag767 then
			local ToolGameplayGuard = require(ReplicatedStorage.Client.ToolGameplayGuard)
			if value641.Parent ~= character or not ToolGameplayGuard.AllowsLocalUse(value641) then
				return "blocked"
			end
			trigger = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes).ToolTrigger.Trigger
		end

		obj.bat = value641

		if flag767 then
			trigger:FireServer(value641)
		else
			value641:Activate()
		end

		obj.lastBat = value641
		obj.batLastUsed[value641] = serverTimeNow
		obj.batReadyAt[value641] = serverTimeNow + (flag767 and 0 or obj.batClientCooldown)
		return "fired"
	end

handlers.createServerBrowser = function(obj)
	local function func371(flag784)
		return type(flag784) == "number" and flag784 == flag784 and flag784 >= 0 and flag784 < math.huge
	end

	return {
		rows = {},
		selected = nil,
		busy = false,
		revision = 0,
		dead = {},
		status = "Enable Find Server or press Refresh",
		lastSuccess = nil,
		nextRefresh = 0,
		Drop = function(list90, param346)
			list90.dead[param346] = true

			for i, row in ipairs(list90.rows) do
				if row.id == param346 then
					table.remove(list90.rows, i)
					break
				end
			end

			if list90.selected == param346 then
				list90.selected = list90.rows[1] and list90.rows[1].id or nil
			end
		end,
		Cancel = function(param347)
			param347.revision = param347.revision + 1
			param347.busy = false
			param347.status = "Find Server off"
			obj.render(param347)
		end,
		Select = function(list91, selected)
			for _, row in ipairs(list91.rows) do
				if row.id == selected then
					list91.selected = selected
					obj.render(list91)
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end,
		Refresh = function(flag785)
			local busy = not obj.alive() or flag785.busy

		Hop = function(list93)

		end

			stealHop.emptySince = nil
			return
		end

			stealHop.emptySince = os.clock()
			return
		end
		local emptySince = stealHop.emptySince
		if os.clock() - emptySince < 2 then
			return
		end
		stealHop.readyAt = os.clock() + 60
		if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
			func38("🟡 Server Hop · history unavailable")
			return
		end
		stealHop.visited[game.JobId] = true
		local flag809 = not value650:Refresh()

		if flag809 then

			if lastSuccess then
				local lastSuccess2 = value650.lastSuccess
				lastSuccess = os.clock() - lastSuccess2 < 90
			end

			flag809 = not lastSuccess
		end

		if flag809 then

			return
		end

		end

				return

			end

			end

			func38("🌐 Finding qualifying eggs in another server")

			return
		end

				logError = tostring(result)
			end

			if logError and logError ~= tbl203.LogError then
				warn("[CloverHub-SAE] AFK log save failed: " .. logError)
			end

			tbl203.LogError = logError

			if ok then
				tbl203.LogDirty = false
			end
		end

		local function func430(param388)
			local n2 = #tbl203.Events + 1
			local started = tbl203.Started
			tbl203.Events[n2] = string.format("[%.2f] %s", os.clock() - started, tostring(param388))

			if #tbl203.Events > 400 then
				table.remove(tbl203.Events, 1)
			end

			tbl203.LogDirty = true
		end

		local function func431()
			return tbl203.Enabled and isAlive()
		end

		local function func432(param389)
			tbl203.Error = tostring(param389)
			func430("ERROR " .. tbl203.Error)
			func429()
			genv.__CHSAE_AFKStartupError = { Message = tbl203.Error, Method = "Targeted game callback + native idle suppression" }
			warn("[CloverHub-SAE] Anti-AFK: " .. tbl203.Error)
		end

		local function func433()
			for k in pairs(chsaeAFKNativeState.Disabled) do
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					if k.Connected == false then
						return
					end
					k:Enable()

					if k.Enabled ~= true then
						error("Idle listener restoration not confirmed")
					end
				end)

				if ok then
					chsaeAFKNativeState.Disabled[k] = nil
				else
					func430("WARN " .. tostring(result))
				end
			end

			for k, controller in pairs(chsaeAFKNativeState.Controllers) do
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					if not k.Parent then
						return
					end
					k.Enabled = controller

					if k.Enabled ~= controller then
						error("AFK controller restoration not confirmed")
					end
				end)

				if ok then
					chsaeAFKNativeState.Controllers[k] = nil
				else
					func430("WARN " .. tostring(result))
				end
			end

			return next(chsaeAFKNativeState.Disabled) == nil and next(chsaeAFKNativeState.Controllers) == nil
		end

		local function chsaeAFKGuardRestore()

			tbl203.Generation = tbl203.Generation + 1
			local flag856 = true

			for i = #tbl203.Connections, 1, -1 do

					tbl203.Connections[i]:Disconnect()
				end)

					table.remove(tbl203.Connections, i)
				else
					func432(result)
					flag856 = false
				end
			end

			flag856 = func433() and flag856
			func430("STOP restored=" .. tostring(flag856) .. " legacyControllersRemoved=" .. tostring(chsaeAFKNativeState.Removed))
			func429()
			return flag856
		end

		end

					end

					end

						error("Idle listener did not report disabled")
					end

					tbl203[str137] = tbl203[str137] + 1

			end
		end
